text:
anya (PM): Quick check — I want to propose trimming the neural reranker out of MVP. Timeline + QA surface area looks risky for the next two sprints. Suggest MVP = baseline ranking + simple boosting + caching; neural reranker -> v1.

mike (eng): +1. Reranker brings an embeddings pipeline + async infra work and ~3 infra tickets. Not comfortable landing it in MVP.

derek (eng-lead): We could do an opt-in canary behind a flag for the pilot customer so they can test without impacting the main rollout. That would reduce rollout risk.

lisa (design): UX impact is small, just result labels and a tiny affordance for "re-ranked by model". Fine to move it out of MVP.

jordan (sales): We have one pilot asking for it. Prefer a canary, but okay if shipped in v1. Need clear comms and dates.

sam (pm): Quick decision needed. My vote: cut neural reranker from MVP, keep caching + boosts in. Action items: create cutlist PR, notify pilot, add canary plan. Owner: anya. Confirm by EOD.

anya (PM): I'll open the PR and update the milestone board. Cutlist sketch:
```
- MVP: baseline ranking (existing signals), simple boosting rules, result caching and prefix KV cache
- v1: neural reranker, per-tenant tuning, realtime embeddings pipeline
- Canary: enable reranker for pilot account behind feature flag (opt-in)
```

mike (eng): One idea — implement a lightweight post-filter rerank (cheap, single-pass) as a stretch if infra effort <= 2 days. Gives pilot some of the value without full pipeline.

derek (eng-lead): Yep add "post-filter lightweight reranker" as a stretch target behind a flag. If estimate is small we can include it as a conditioned MVP task.

lisa (design): I'll draft the minimal label copy + microcopy doc for the flag UI and the result label.

jordan (sales): I'll draft customer comms and a timeline to share with the pilot by tomorrow.

anya (PM): OK consensus. I'll update the milestone and create tickets. @derek please confirm infra estimate for the post-filter option by tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
